h1: B2 Ubon Boutique & Budget Hotel — a budget chain hotel near Ubon airport with rooms newer and cleaner than the price suggests
intro: If you are flying or driving into Ubon and want somewhere new, clean and gentle on the wallet without rolling the dice on quality, B2 Ubon Boutique & Budget Hotel is a name guests mention often — part of the B2 chain found across Thailand, newly opened in 2025 with around 92 rooms in the Rai Noi area near Ubon airport · Rooms are bright and modern, clean, with an on-site restaurant and free parking · It scores a high 9.0 on Trip.com from 223 reviews · From approx ฿550/night.

body.html: What earns B2 Ubon Boutique & Budget Hotel a high score among budget options is how new and clean it is · The hotel only opened in 2025, so the rooms and common areas are still fresh, in the bright, modern style that is the B2 chain's signature · Reviews repeatedly call the rooms clean, the beds comfortable and the air conditioning cold — and great value · Anyone who knows the B2 chain from other provinces will feel instantly at home.

It sits in the Rai Noi area, on the airport side of town · The hotel is close to Ubon Ratchathani Airport (UBP), about 8 km away or roughly a 15-minute drive, and about 10 minutes from the city centre · There are convenience stores, restaurants and a market nearby for finding food on foot · That makes it a strong pick for travellers flying in and out of Ubon, here for a short errand, or arriving by car and wanting free parking at a new, low-priced hotel.
"New, clean room, comfortable bed and cold air conditioning, very friendly staff — superb value for the price. It is on a big road but the room is quiet, with restaurants and a market nearby."

There are several room types by size and occupancy · From the Superior Room (two single beds), Deluxe Premier (a large bed for two), Deluxe Triple (for three) up to the Family Suite (for up to five) · Every room comes in a modern style with an LED TV, fridge/minibar and free Wi-Fi · Guests consistently praise how new, bright and clean the rooms look — good for solo travellers, couples and families wanting a larger room at a budget price.

To be straight about it, this is a budget hotel, not a luxury one, and there are limits worth knowing before booking · The one guests mention most is that there is no lift, so if you land a room on the 2nd or 3rd floor you carry your luggage up the stairs, which is tiring with heavy bags · On top of that, breakfast is not included and there is no swimming pool · It is a chain hotel focused on new, clean rooms at a low price rather than resort-style facilities.

The scores back up the picture · B2 Ubon earns around 9.0 on Trip.com from 223 reviews and ranks near the top of Ubon's hotels on TripAdvisor too · A high review count plus a high score reflects that the hotel reliably delivers what people expect from the B2 chain — new, clean rooms, friendly staff and good value.

In short, B2 Ubon Boutique & Budget Hotel is a new, low-priced chain hotel near Ubon airport with rooms cleaner than the price suggests · It suits travellers flying in and out of Ubon, here on errands, or arriving by car wanting a new room with free parking · If you expect a lift, in-house breakfast, a pool or a walkable city-centre location, this may not be the fit · But if you want a new, clean room, good value and close to the airport, this is a solid choice.

A tip from following the reviews: if you have a lot of luggage, ask for a ground-floor room when you book, as there is no lift · Plan to grab breakfast from the restaurants and market nearby, since rooms do not include it · And if you are travelling as a group or family, look at the Deluxe Triple or Family Suite for a larger room at good value.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — B2 Ubon Boutique & Budget Hotel Ubon Ratchathani

faq.q: Where is B2 Ubon Boutique & Budget Hotel and how do I get there?
faq.a: It is at 499 Moo 12 in the Rai Noi area, on the airport side of Ubon Ratchathani near the airport (UBP) · The airport is about 8 km away, roughly a 15-minute drive · The city centre and Thung Si Muang are about 12 minutes by car · Convenience stores, restaurants and a market are a few minutes' walk away.

faq.q: How much does B2 Ubon cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start at approximately ฿550/night for a Superior Room · A Deluxe Premier is around ฿650, a Deluxe Triple (for three) around ฿800, and a Family Suite (for up to five) from around ฿1,200 · Prices vary by season and city events, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does the hotel have a lift and breakfast?
faq.a: There is no lift · If you land a room on the 2nd or 3rd floor you carry bags up the stairs, so ask for a ground-floor room if you have a lot of luggage · And breakfast is not included, though there is an on-site restaurant and shops/market nearby for food · There is free parking and free Wi-Fi.

faq.q: What are the rooms like and are they new?
faq.a: The hotel opened in 2025, so rooms are bright, modern, clean, with comfortable beds and cold air conditioning, plus an LED TV, fridge/minibar and free Wi-Fi · There are several types from Superior (two singles) to Family Suite (for five) · Guests praise the newness, cleanliness and value most of all.

faq.q: Who is B2 Ubon Boutique & Budget Hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits travellers flying in and out of Ubon who want a new, clean, well-priced room near the airport, or drivers wanting free parking · It works for solo travellers, couples and families wanting a larger room at a budget price · It is not ideal for those who want a lift, in-house breakfast, a pool, or a walkable city-centre location.

faq.q: What are B2 Ubon's review scores?
faq.a: It earns around 9.0 on Trip.com from 223 reviews and ranks near the top of Ubon's hotels on TripAdvisor too · Most guests are happy with the new, clean rooms, the friendly staff and the value.
